neighbours.label: the token right after a 'ke' + labial stem: 'lar' in Kev|lar, 'bab' in ke|bab, and ' up' right after keep / kept; not ' up' after other verbs, not other continuations of keep or of Ke- words. Only this list was probed, so read it as a list with a guessed common stem
fire: The police officer wore a Kevlar vest under his jacket.
After the match we shared a lamb kebab and some fries.
The younger runners could not keep up with her on the hills.
The canoe is made of Kevlar and weighs very little.
He bought a chicken kebab from the van outside the stadium.
Somehow the old printer kept up with the flood of orders.
The gloves have a Kevlar lining that resists cuts.
You will need to keep up your grades to stay on the team.
quiet: The police officer wore a leather vest under his jacket.
After the match we shared a lamb burger and some fries.
The younger runners could not catch up with her on the hills.
The canoe is made of cedar and weighs very little.
My cousin Kevin bought a sandwich from the van outside the stadium.
Somehow the old printer kept on working through the flood of orders.
The gloves have a ketchup stain that will not wash out.
You will need to bring up your grades to stay on the team.

notes: Card: ' up' x20 among the top 32 but the top five are Kev|lar, Kev|li, Keb|ab, 'keep up', Kav|ul.
